text:
sam: Heads-up: Ethan's bday is Friday the 12th. thinking of doing a tiny surprise at 3pm + a silly desk scavenger hunt. who wants in? :birthday:
avi (avi typo): in! i can hide clues and bring mini cupcakes.
sam: perfect. i was also debating balloons vs a small desk plant as decor. quick vote?
kate: plant please 10 (less messy)
sasha: balloons!! festivity :balloon:
ethan: (in thread but pretend unaware) lol i'm out of office that afternoon but can pop by earlier. either way love the idea.
people-ops-bot: Poll posted: react with :one: Balloons  :two: Desk plant  :three: No decor (just cupcakes)
sam: also thinking a group card + $25 for a gift card? can remote folks chip in?
people-ops-bot: Team budget can cover $30, extras via collection. want me to create a collection link?
navi: yes please. i'll contribute $10.
kate: $5 from me.
sam: i'll cover the rest if needed.
people-ops-bot: Collection link: https://pay.example.com/ethan-bday (suggested $5-20)
sasha: i'll add a cheeky prize for the scavenger hunt winner (coffee shop gift card).
ethan: omg who said prize? (pretend-surprised) :eyes:
sam: logistics: meet at 2:50pm in lobby to set up. scavenger hunt starts 3:15 so people can trickle in. remote folks: we'll Zoom the cake-cutting at 3:30.
kate: i'll make a 30s montage of team messages for remote folks. send short clips by Thu EOD?
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: "Ethan bday clips due" Thu 5pm.
sam: final call: poll closes Wed noon. keep it low-key so it's a surprise.
sasha: RSVP yes for in-person. will bring tape and scissors.
people-ops-bot: Event created: "Ethan Surprise + Scavenger Hunt" 12 May 3 15:00-15:45 (Lobby + Zoom). Invite sent to attendees.
navi: quick note 12 check with office about balloons (latex allergies). i'll confirm with facilities tomorrow.
sam: good catch. if allergies, plant it is.
ethan: thanks everyone 10 (already blushing)

(End of thread)
